dogecoin.text:
This is what laboratories of democracy is all about:  a national competition between states to come up with the best incentive for the vaccine-resistant.

New Jersey: beer
Oregon: wine
Tennessee: whiskey shot
Florida: body shot
Texas: one week free AC
California: $5 of dogecoin
@conorsen it's a pretty demoralizing blow to my "much savings, very little to do" thesis that dogecoin is surging while the economy is opening up

Where the dogecoin story stands: 

a parody of an online currency that some people treat as a form of digital gold, based on a meme about a talking Shiba Inu, which fluctuates on things like who is hosting SNL this weekend, now has a bigger market cap than 80% of the S&P 500 https://t.co/1ZdIM3244o
